stories.title: LeBron chooses 76ers, calls it his 'last decision'...
stories.summary: LeBron James, after considering retirement, is continuing his NBA career with the 76ers. James is taking a two-year, $8 million deal, Klutch Sports Group CEO Rich Paul told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Mahomes fully cleared for camp, feeling 'amazing'
stories.summary: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes has been cleared to fully participate in training camp after knee surgery last year.

stories.title: Packers CEO questions team's financial viability
stories.summary: Packers president/CEO Ed Policy said adjustments might be necessary as the NFL's only publicly owned franchise attempts to remain financially competitive in the long term.

stories.title: Roberts: Dodgers won't rush Ohtani's mound return
stories.summary: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said he doesn't expect Shohei Ohtani to return to the rotation by next week, saying the team wouldn't have him pitch "earlier than we need to."

stories.title: Obama holds surprise visit with WNBA All-Stars
stories.summary: Former President Barack Obama visited with the WNBA All-Stars on Friday, professing his fandom for the women's game and taking photos with the players, including Caitlin Clark and Angel Reese.
